parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paging query.

parameters.name: HashKey
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the file.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on each page in a paging query.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The filter condition based on instance name or IP address.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The event status. Valid values:

- **1**: Unhandled.
- **2**: Blocked.
- **3**: Ignored.

parameters.name: Uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the server to query.
